AboutMe.title: About me
AboutMe.content: Hello, I'm Robert Santos, a Full Stack Developer with 1 year of professional experience in the field, currently pursuing a degree in Systems Analysis and Development. I'm a technology enthusiast and passionate about solving complex problems, born and raised in Salvador, Brazil. I specialize in developing systems that deliver value to the market.

StacksPage.description: These are the technologies and tools I have learned throughout my career, during college, courses, and personal projects. Feel free to explore and discover the technologies that have enhanced my expertise in development.

streaminginteractions.title: Streaming Interactions
streaminginteractions.description:
Browser extension published on the Chrome Web Store that adds a floating sidebar to streaming sites like Netflix, Disney+, Crunchyroll, and others, allowing users to read, comment, and reply to other comments about the episode or movie they are watching in real time.
Stacks: React, Typescript, Zustand.

eplay.title: eplay
eplay.description: Educational project for a game store, with features to add and remove items from the cart and covering the entire shopping journey. Developed using React and Redux for global state management.
